views.name: customer_balances
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.customer_id,
  SUM(c.txn_amount) AS cumulative_balance
FROM customer_transactions AS c
GROUP BY c.customer_id
views.description: Calculate the cumulative balance for each customer.

views.name: monthly_balances_initial
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    'January' AS Month,
    SUM(sales) OVER (PARTITION BY "month_number" ORDER BY "month_number" ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS "Initial Balance"
FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
WHERE "month_number" = 1
views.description: Calculate the initial balance for each month based on the first month's balance.

views.name: final_monthly_balances
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m', t1.week_date_formatted) AS "Month",
    SUM(t1.sales) AS "Total Balance"
FROM cleaned_weekly_sales AS t1
GROUP BY "Month"
views.description: Clean and format the calculated balances for the final output.

views.name: daily_transactions
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.txn_date AS transaction_date,
    c.txn_amount AS transaction_amount
FROM customer_transactions AS c
views.description: Extracts daily transaction data for each customer.

views.name: product_views
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(shopping_cart_page_hierarchy.product_id) AS view_count
FROM shopping_cart_page_hierarchy
WHERE shopping_cart_page_hierarchy.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
views.description: Selects product view counts based on page ID.

views.name: product_abandoned_carts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  'abandoned_cart_count' AS abandoned_cart_count,
  sp.product_id AS product_id
FROM shopping_cart_page_hierarchy AS sp
WHERE
  sp.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
views.description: Selects product abandoned cart counts based on page ID.

views.name: monthly_interest_data
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    DATE(T1.month_year) AS date,
    T2.interest_name AS interest_name,
    T3.index_value AS index_composition
FROM
    interest_metrics AS T1
INNER JOIN
    interest_map AS T2
    ON T1.interest_id = T2.id
INNER JOIN
    interest_metrics AS T3
    ON T1.interest_id = T3.interest_id
WHERE
    T1.month_year BETWEEN '2018-09-01' AND '2019-08-31'
views.description: Extracts monthly interest data with relevant columns.

views.name: interest_composition
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    im."interest_name",
    SUM(im."composition") AS "composition_value"
FROM
    interest_map AS im
JOIN
    interest_metrics AS im
ON
    im."interest_id" = im."interest_id"
GROUP BY
    im."interest_name"
views.description: Calculates the total composition value for each interest across all months.

views.name: btc_purchases_yearly
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    strftime('%Y', txn_date) AS year,
    member_id AS region,
    SUM(quantity) AS total_btc_quantity,
    SUM(quantity) AS total_btc_amount
FROM
    bitcoin_transactions
WHERE
    strftime('%Y', txn_date) >= '2023'
GROUP BY
    year,
    member_id
views.description: Calculate total Bitcoin purchase amount and quantity for each year and region.

views.name: btc_avg_price_yearly
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    btc_purchases_yearly.year AS year,
    btc_purchases_yearly.region AS region,
    AVG(btc_purchases_yearly.total_btc_amount) AS avg_btc_price
FROM
    btc_purchases_yearly
GROUP BY
    btc_purchases_yearly.year,
    btc_purchases_yearly.region
views.description: Calculate the average purchase price per Bitcoin for each region for each year.

views.name: category_wholesale_summary_2020_2023
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    v1."category_name" AS category,
    STRFTIME('%Y', v2."whsle_date") AS year,
    AVG(v2."whsle_px_rmb-kg") AS average_wholesale_price,
    MAX(v2."whsle_px_rmb-kg") AS maximum_wholesale_price,
    MIN(v2."whsle_px_rmb-kg") AS minimum_wholesale_price,
    SUM(v2."whsle_px_rmb-kg") AS total_wholesale_price
FROM "veg_whsle_df" v2
JOIN "veg_cat" v1 ON v2."item_code" = v1."index"
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', v2."whsle_date") BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'
GROUP BY v1."category_name", STRFTIME('%Y', v2."whsle_date")
views.description: Calculate summary statistics (average, max, min, total) for wholesale prices by category and year.

views.name: sales_by_week
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    T1.week_number,
    SUM(T1.sales) AS total_sales
FROM cleaned_weekly_sales AS T1
GROUP BY T1.week_number
views.description: Aggregates sales amount by week for each year.

views.name: sales_by_time_window
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    t1.sales_amount,
    t1.time_window
FROM (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN week_date BETWEEN DATE('2020-06-15', '-12 weeks') AND DATE('2020-06-15') THEN '12 weeks before June 15, 2020'
            WHEN week_date BETWEEN DATE('2020-06-15') AND DATE('2020-06-15', '+1 week') THEN 'June 15, 2020 - 0 weeks'
            WHEN week_date BETWEEN DATE('2020-06-15', '+1 week') AND DATE('2020-06-15', '+12 weeks') THEN 'June 15, 2020 - 12 weeks'
            ELSE 'Other'
        END AS time_window,
        SUM(sales) AS sales_amount
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE week_date BETWEEN DATE('2020-06-15', '-12 weeks') AND DATE('2020-06-15', '+12 weeks')
    GROUP BY time_window
) t1

semantic_filters.value: between DATE('2020-06-15', '-12 weeks') AND DATE('2020-06-15', '+12 weeks')

views.description: Calculate sales for each time window (12 weeks before and after June 15, 2020).

views.name: sales_by_attribute
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    'region' AS attribute_type,
    AVG(sales) AS average_percentage_change
FROM
    cleaned_weekly_sales
GROUP BY
    attribute_type
views.description: Aggregate sales by attribute type (region, platform, age band, demographic, and customer type).
